headline: Travelers Expands Product Liability Insurance to California Life Sciences Companies
summary: HARTFORD, Conn., July 28, 2026--The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV) today announced that Travelers Synergy® – its product liability insurance offering for life sciences companies – is now available in California, completing its rollout across all 50 states.
